summary:
is both a key importer and exporter of crude oil
It is hard to overestimate the importance of the United States in the tanker market. It is a large importer and exporter of both refined products and crude oil, and as a result it generates a lot of ton-mile demand for tankers. In this Week's Tanker Opinion, we will focus on the role of the U.S.
